description: On an infinite type, an ultrafilter is nonprincipal exactly when it refines the cofinite filter.
signature:
Lemmatheca.Entry.FiltersAndUltrafilters.nonprincipal_iff_cofinite.{u} {α : Type u} [Infinite α] (U : Ultrafilter α) :
  ¬Lemmatheca.Entry.FiltersAndUltrafilters.IsPrincipal ↑U ↔ ↑U ≤ Filter.cofinite
